register.labelZh: HIT 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: hit back 表示某人受到批評或攻擊後作出強硬回應;hit out 則可以描述某人突然試圖揮打另一個人。；hit it off 表示兩人很快便相處投契;hit on somebody 則表示一個人向另一個人調情或表示愛慕之意。；當某人突然或意外地想到一個主意、答案或解決方法時,可以使用 hit on 或 hit upon。；hit somebody up for something 和 hit somebody for something 常見於談論向別人開口要錢或借錢的非正式對話。
register.summaryEn: Hit back shows that someone responds strongly after being criticised or attacked. Hit out can describe someone suddenly trying to strike another person. Hit it off means that two people quickly become friendly. Hit on somebody means that one person shows romantic interest in another. Hit on and hit upon are useful when someone suddenly or unexpectedly thinks of an idea, answer or solution. Hit somebody up for something and hit somebody for something often appear in informal conversations about asking someone for money.
